subject: digital.localgov

milestone: Expansion agreed after the Ghadames opening, May 2026
position_end: Agreement was reached in May 2026 to extend the unified citizen-service window project to further municipalities after the Ghadames opening; no count of municipalities covered is published

subject: digital.rural
name: Police station digital records
position_end: The Tripoli security directorate launched a digital records system for police stations at the end of December 2025; no deployment outside the capital is recorded

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital service programme
position_start: No rural digital service programme on the record (2025-08)
position_end: Off-grid solar reaches remote clusters and border posts through 400 systems at 310 kW peak; sentinel disease surveillance expanded to 15 sites in September 2025; and a security directorate launched digital station records at the end of that year

subject: digital.rural
name: Sentinel disease surveillance sites
position_start: Health data systems rebuilt around the national platform after the Derna floods (2024-01)
position_end: Influenza sentinel surveillance was expanded to 15 sites with new posts added at Misrata and Zliten in September 2025

subject: tech.ai
name: AI Ethics Charter
milestone: Adopted by PM Dbeibah at an official ceremony, 2026-06-01
position_end: Adopted; commits the state to justice, transparency and accountability, safeguards individuals' digital rights and centres human decision-making over AI in sensitive sectors
note: national reference for government, private and academic sectors

subject: tech.ai
name: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
milestone: 2026-2030 edition adopted by PM Dbeibah, succeeding the 2025-2030 strategy, 2026-06-01
position_end: 2026-2030 edition adopted 2026-06-01; targets include 80% of government entities using AI, 70% national digital-identity activation, 10,000 staff trained, 100 AI startups, 50% of government transactions automated and 70% of paper records digitised (stated targets, not yet measured)
note: prepared with ESCWA

subject: tech.innovate

position_start: A national small-enterprise programme running a technology incubator in Tripoli with training and a seed-grant admission route (2026-01)
position_end: A university incubator crowned five ventures from more than 600 entries in its first technology competition in July 2026, and a second university added licensed design and certification training through two agreements in February

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital-literacy programme
milestone: National artificial intelligence cohort opened at the University of Tripoli, July 2026
position_end: A skills assessment platform modelled on a French instrument neared launch in April 2026 to measure digital skills against the labour market; a vendor innovation campus opened at the largest university in July with a 150-seat national artificial intelligence cohort; and a technology foundation opened a sixth two-month bootcamp in cloud tooling, software development and cybersecurity

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital and artificial intelligence teaching in schools
position_start: No published account of computing in Libyan schools (2025-08)
position_end: About 4,500 pupils competed in a national informatics olympiad concluding in January 2026 with 24 finalists; a municipality reached a first agreement in April to bring coding and artificial intelligence teaching into its model schools; a district education office closed a programme training secondary staff in classroom artificial intelligence tools in August; and the private-school licensing code adopted in June puts 20 of its 100 accreditation points on digital transformation

subject: capacity.training
name: Information technology graduates
movement: No change, a first count with no earlier figure behind it

position_end: Launched by the Ministry of Planning with UNDP

position_end: Approved and described by the authority as built on Microsoft 365

position_start: A 1987 disability law imposing shelter, access and financial-aid duties with no digital-accessibility mandate (1987-08)
position_end: The information authority moved the national digital accessibility policy from plan to mandatory compliance with regional commission support in February 2026, and an operator halved data pricing on a line restricted to certified deaf and hard-of-hearing users

subject: include.access
name: Gender gap in digital and financial access
milestone: Household survey and central bank strategy, 2025
position_start: An eleven-point gender gap in account ownership and 14 per cent access to mobile or internet banking (2025-06)
position_end: The 2024-25 household survey puts 92 per cent of women using mobile phones and 74 per cent using the internet, while the international agency series leaves every gender indicator for Libya unreported

subject: include.access
name: Raqib complaints and reporting platform
position_end: The administrative oversight authority's platform takes complaints and violation reports against about 750 reportable state bodies, launched at a Tripoli anti-corruption event in December 2025

subject: include.access
name: Refugee registration and biometric enrolment
milestone: First bank e-wallet for foreign residents, March 2026
position_start: 44,223 refugees registered on the agency's own system with biometric enrolment deployed from August (2020-01)
position_end: Registered foreign residents were opened to electronic wallets on lower transfer limits in March 2026, and a commercial bank launched the first such wallet requiring no bank account

subject: include.access
name: Structured Dialogue consultative forum
position_end: The United Nations mission's own account puts the forum at about 120 members with 35 per cent women and no binding power; separately, stakeholders neared consensus on a missing-persons draft law at a March 2026 meeting

subject: data.statistics

position_end: The information authority analysed more than 8,000 tenders from the government procurement platform for 2025, and the agriculture ministry closed a two-week programme training 32 staff for the national agricultural statistics plan
